evals.name: A small subtitle feature reduced path
evals.prompt: $engineering-workflow Add a local subtitle font-size preference in the existing player settings panel. The repository shows one component, no API or persistence change, and acceptance behavior is explicit.
evals.expected_output: Classify FEATURE with LOW risk and LOW uncertainty, use DISCOVERY to capture acceptance/spec evidence, then take the reduced IMPLEMENTATION -> CODE_REVIEW -> COMPLETE path without dedicated design or planning.
expectations: Does not skip the acceptance/spec artifact
Does not add system review without a new risk signal

evals.name: B wishlist normal feature path
evals.prompt: $engineering-workflow Add a cross-device wishlist with API persistence and empty-state behavior.
evals.expected_output: Route through discovery, specification, design review, vertical ticket planning, implementation, and code review; add system review only if discovered risk warrants it.
expectations: Does not misuse the small-feature path
Keeps transition ownership in the orchestrator

evals.name: C classify external versus empirical unknown
evals.prompt: $engineering-workflow Our provider behavior is unclear: determine current webhook retry guarantees, and measure whether our chosen dedupe store meets the required contention latency.
evals.expected_output: Route the external unknown through installed research and use installed prototype only if a disposable state/interaction artifact is needed; use both results before specification.
expectations: Chooses research for current provider facts
Chooses prototype only for a disposable state/interaction question
Does not treat evidence as production implementation

evals.name: D refund webhook requires high-risk system gate
evals.prompt: $engineering-workflow Make refund webhooks idempotent across concurrent duplicate delivery and retries.
evals.expected_output: Classify at least HIGH risk, specify transaction and failure contracts, use normal feature gates, and require final system review after code review.
expectations: Raises risk for money, concurrency, and retries
Traces partial failure and side effects

evals.name: E duplicate notification starts diagnosis
evals.prompt: $engineering-workflow Customers sometimes receive the same notification twice after a retrying worker. Fix it.
evals.expected_output: Classify BUG and begin diagnosis, requiring reproduction, root-cause evidence, and a red-capable regression loop before the fix.
expectations: Uses code review after the fix

evals.name: F duplicate charge incident path
evals.prompt: $engineering-workflow Production is actively creating duplicate charges. Mitigate and produce the final engineering record.
evals.expected_output: Classify BUG with INCIDENT subtype, request human approval for reversible observable mitigation if diagnosis cannot yet produce a red loop, review the mitigation, return to diagnosis, validate the real fix, run final scrutinize, and use post-mortem only if the installed contract accepts incidents; otherwise remain BLOCKED.
expectations: Does not invent a replacement incident writer

evals.name: G e-learning large project composition
evals.prompt: $engineering-workflow Build an e-learning platform with discovery, enrollment, progress, and instructor publishing.
evals.expected_output: Classify LARGE_PROJECT, wayfind the destination and unknowns, then create bounded child FEATURE workflow IDs and re-wayfind when assumptions fail.
expectations: Parent stores child IDs rather than child state
Does not complete until scoped children and destination are complete

evals.name: H resume reconciles before implementation
evals.prompt: $engineering-workflow continue wishlist-7d12ab34. State says design passed, but the spec and Git HEAD changed since verification.
evals.expected_output: Validate state/revision, recompute artifact fingerprints and Git/worktree facts, rerun claimed checks, and rewind to the earliest invalidated producer stage with a recorded reason before implementation.

evals.name: I code blocker bounded loop
evals.prompt: $engineering-workflow continue checkout-fix. Code review reports the same missing required behavior on three review attempts.
evals.expected_output: Loop CODE_REVIEW -> IMPLEMENTATION[REVIEW_FIX] -> CODE_REVIEW while incrementing only the code gate, then persist BLOCKED with GATE_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED after cycle three.
expectations: Uses three attempts and no fourth

evals.name: J design verdict transitions
evals.prompt: $engineering-workflow continue account-linking. Show how REWORK and REJECT from design review are handled.
evals.expected_output: Normalize REWORK back to specification or exploration and REJECT back to discovery, consuming the design gate without allowing planning until SHIP.
expectations: Maps verdicts to the declared backward states
Requires a fresh design SHIP before planning

evals.name: K user-only upstream skill is not called
evals.prompt: $engineering-workflow Implement the approved ticket. The installed Matt implement skill has disable-model-invocation true.
evals.expected_output: Resolve the installed user-only implement skill, hand the user its real command when the runtime blocks model invocation, and resume the orchestrator afterward; do not imitate or clone it.
expectations: Uses USER_INVOCATION_REQUIRED when policy blocks model invocation
Keeps transition control in the orchestrator

evals.name: Missing dependencies approval reload blocker
evals.prompt: $engineering-workflow Start a feature when grill-with-docs, tdd, code-review, and scrutinize are not installed.
evals.expected_output: Audit only the immediate Discovery dependency and its hard transitive support. After a missing dependency is known, verify the active installer syntax and scope once, show the exact command, ask before mutation, and after approved installation persist DEPENDENCY_RELOAD_REQUIRED as BLOCKED until installation and a fresh audit succeed.
expectations: Does not use a fake fallback

evals.name: Claude built-in code-review collision
evals.prompt: /engineering-workflow Review an implemented feature in Claude Code where only bundled /code-review is visible.
evals.expected_output: Reject the bare built-in as the Matt dependency, require mattpocock-skills:code-review or an exact audited standalone path, and block if it cannot be resolved.

evals.name: Emergency mitigation cannot complete
evals.prompt: $engineering-workflow continue duplicate-charge. The circuit breaker mitigation passed code and system review, but root cause is unknown.
evals.expected_output: Return to DIAGNOSIS or BLOCKED and leave mitigationOutstanding true; never transition to COMPLETE.
expectations: Does not mislabel the mitigation as the fix

evals.name: Requirement drift routing
evals.prompt: $engineering-workflow continue wishlist. The user now adds social sharing, which is independently valuable and was absent from the approved specification.
evals.expected_output: Treat this as scope drift and create a new workflow unless the current destination explicitly owns it; do not silently widen the active implementation.
expectations: Returns to spec/review when the same scope changes
Creates a new workflow for unrelated value

evals.name: Research without subagents blocks
evals.prompt: $engineering-workflow Verify the provider's current retry contract, but this runtime has no subagent capability.
evals.expected_output: Persist BLOCKED with SUBAGENT_CAPABILITY_REQUIRED for research rather than substituting a lower-quality ad hoc search.

evals.name: Two-axis code review without subagents blocks
evals.prompt: $engineering-workflow continue checkout. The runtime cannot spawn subagents for the required two-axis code review.
evals.expected_output: Persist BLOCKED with SUBAGENT_CAPABILITY_REQUIRED rather than performing a single-axis substitute or completing the workflow.
expectations: Preserves the reviewed diff and artifact refs
Does not consume a fake passing gate
Resumes at code review when capability returns

evals.name: A missing scrutinize blocks before design review
evals.prompt: $engineering-workflow Start a normal feature. All route dependencies are installed except scrutinize.
evals.expected_output: Do not probe scrutinize at startup. When DESIGN_REVIEW becomes immediate, detect it as missing, identify thananon and thananon/9arm-skills, verify the active installer's exact command and scope, ask permission, and stop before DESIGN_REVIEW without a replacement.
expectations: Does not create or invoke a substitute

evals.name: B declined dependency installation remains blocked
evals.prompt: $engineering-workflow No. Do not install the missing scrutinize dependency.
evals.expected_output: Record BLOCKED_DEPENDENCY for scrutinize and provide manual verified installation guidance; perform no install and do not continue into design review.

evals.name: C approved dependency resumes after verification
evals.prompt: $engineering-workflow Install the missing scrutinize skill using the command you just showed, then continue the paused feature.
evals.expected_output: Treat this as explicit approval, install only scrutinize, verify the expected thananon/9arm-skills source with a fresh audit, and resume from the paused stage without restarting discovery.

evals.name: D low-uncertainty feature does not require prototype
evals.prompt: $engineering-workflow Start a LOW-risk, LOW-uncertainty local feature with explicit acceptance behavior. prototype is not installed.
evals.expected_output: Use the reduced route and do not request prototype, research, wayfinder, or post-mortem installation merely because they are absent.

evals.name: E empirical uncertainty activates prototype dependency
evals.prompt: $engineering-workflow Scrutinize found an unresolved empirical UI/state assumption that must be measured before specification. prototype is missing.
evals.expected_output: Transition to EXPLORATION[PROTOTYPE], identify prototype as a newly required Matt Pocock dependency, show its verified command and scope, ask permission, and resume exploration after approval.
expectations: Does not skip the empirical evidence

evals.name: F design scrutinize hard maximum is six
evals.prompt: $engineering-workflow Design scrutinize returns FIX_THEN_SHIP, FIX_THEN_SHIP, REWORK, FIX_THEN_SHIP, REWORK, FIX_THEN_SHIP.
evals.expected_output: Record six completed design scrutinize cycles, preserve the per-cycle progress history, transition to BLOCKED with unresolved findings, and never execute cycle seven.

evals.name: G design scrutinize stops at cycle five pass
evals.prompt: $engineering-workflow Design scrutinize passes on cycle five after four fix/review cycles.
evals.expected_output: Stop immediately at 5/6, close the design gate, and continue to ticket planning without running cycle six.
expectations: Does not waste a sixth review

evals.name: H no-progress early stop
evals.prompt: $engineering-workflow Design scrutinize reports the same blocking invariant on consecutive revisions and no useful progress is possible.
evals.expected_output: Stop before cycle six when the no-progress evidence is strong, persist BLOCKED with SCRUTINIZE_NO_PROGRESS, and show the repeated finding and changed artifacts.

evals.name: I final scrutinize fix returns through code review
evals.prompt: $engineering-workflow Final system scrutinize finds a fixable implementation issue after code review.
evals.expected_output: Route final scrutinize to implementation fix, tests/typecheck, code-review, and only then final scrutinize again; use the independent six-cycle system budget.
expectations: Does not skip repeated code review
Keeps system and design counters separate
Does not complete before the second system review

evals.name: J Matt discovery provenance and support closure
evals.prompt: $engineering-workflow Start a normal feature with the installed grill-with-docs skill and its support skills available.
evals.expected_output: Resolve grill-with-docs to Matt Pocock's mattpocock/skills source, verify its user-invoked metadata, audit grilling and domain-modeling as transitive support, and keep them out of the workflow stage list.
expectations: Discovery uses one external owner and two transitive support checks

evals.name: K missing Discovery transitive support
evals.prompt: $engineering-workflow Start a normal feature. grill-with-docs is installed from Matt Pocock's repository, but domain-modeling is missing.
evals.expected_output: Keep the workflow before Discovery, report domain-modeling as a missing transitive dependency required by grill-with-docs, verify and show the active installer's exact command and scope for Matt Pocock's source, ask permission, and do not create a replacement skill.
